source.note: From Kamran Cloud (kamran-cloud.vercel.app), the site of Dr. Kamran Khan, Department of Applied Mathematics, ZHCET AMU, shared with his permission. Notes, lecture plans, exercises and tutorial sheets are his own: set author and professor to 'Dr. Kamran Khan'. Folder 'B.Tech/1st Year/Applied Mathematics 1' = AMS1112, 'Applied Mathematics 2' = AMS1122; 'BE/Ist year' = the B.E. twins EAMS1112/EAMS1122 (same course folders). 2nd Year 'Vector Calculus' and 'Numerical Methods' are the 2nd-year Higher Mathematics / Numerical Methods courses. Folder names are the site's own section labels (chapters/units). 'Books' folders hold published books: not ours to share. M.Tech AMS6211 is not a B.Tech course.
